questions.question: King Josiah of Judah stood by the pillar before the LORD in the temple. What did he make there?

answers.text: A covenant to follow the LORD
A plan to rebuild the city walls
A vow to never go to war

questions.question: King Josiah ordered the priests to clear out the temple of the LORD. What did he have them remove?

answers.text: The articles made for Baal and Asherah
The timber bought for the repairs
